instruction: Change the slide number color to red in my LibreOffice Impress presentation to make them easier to see.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the slide number color to red in LibreOffice Impress (similar to original but with different instruction wording). Uses existing check_page_number_colors metric function that checks the slide master's page number color. The evaluator verifies that the slide number color meets the red threshold (R > G+50 and R > B+50).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic can verify the slide number color requirement
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) to persist PPTX changes before verification
Metric function correctly handles 'expected' parameter when type='rule' (uses rules['color'] directly, not rules.get('rules'))
Color detection logic (is_red: R > G+50 and R > B+50) is semantically reasonable for detecting red colors

WARNING: The hardcoded index assumes specific XML structure - may not work for all presentation templates or LibreOffice versions
